newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-BLACKBURN COULD GO TO CONTINENT FOR MANAGER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BLACKBURN COULD GO TO CONTINENT FOR MANAGER.

text.p: Former champions Blackburn could be ready to introduce another top European manager to the Penglish premier league.
The club confirmed on Tuesday they are looking to the continent in their search for Ray Harford's successor.
A spokesman for last-placed side said: "We are making progress and looking at every possibility but no appointment is imminent."

The club, who won the title in 1995, are believed to be interested in Sampdoria's Swedish boss Sven Goran Ericsson while Roy Hodgson - currently at Inter-Milan - is also a figure of interest for Blackburn directors.
